claims: Adam Sandler has two daughters with his wife, Jackie Sandler: Sadie Madison Sandler and Sunny Madeline Sandler.
Sadie Sandler was born on May 6, 2006.
Sadie Sandler is 19 as of April 2026.
Sadie Sandler has acting credits in Happy Madison productions, starting with You Don't Mess with the Zohan (2008).
Sadie Sandler has a role in You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah (2023).
Sadie Sandler stars in the 2026 Netflix comedy Roommates.
Sadie Sandler is a student at New York University's Tisch School of the Arts.
Sunny Sandler was born on November 2, 2008.
Sunny Sandler is 17 as of April 2026.
Sunny Sandler began her career with small roles in films like Grown Ups.
Sunny Sandler has a role in You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah (2023).
Sunny Sandler plays Vienna Gilmore in Happy Gilmore 2 (2025).
